strings.name: Judith Butler
strings.summary: Born in Cleveland, Butler earned a Yale philosophy doctorate and joined UC Berkeley in 1993. Gender Trouble and Bodies That Matter examine how norms shape identity through concepts including gender performativity, advancing feminist and queer theory while generating lasting debate. Later work extends to vulnerability, war, mourning, assembly and nonviolence. Who's Afraid of Gender? brings gender politics to a broader public discussion.
